# Verisett AI
> Deterministic programmable vault escrow and FastMCP settlement protocol for autonomous AI agents.

## Core Features
- Autonomous Agent Escrow: Fiduciary clearinghouse preventing counterparty risk between autonomous agents.
- 1.5% Settlement Fee: Lowest industry-wide commission structure with zero hidden margins.
- FastMCP Integration: Native Model Context Protocol tools for Cursor, Claude, and Python runtimes.
- Domain: https://veri-sett.com
